map.评估质量评价 = 方案科学性 + 项目全面性 + 数据准确性 + 解读专业性 +: Assessment quality score = the average of scheme scientificity + item comprehensiveness + data accuracy + interpretation professionalism + recommendation actionability (each 0 to 5); at least 4.5 is excellent, at least 3.5 good and at least 2.5 average.
map.健身评估质量优化机制（5维度，每项1-5分）: Fitness assessment quality optimisation mechanism (5 dimensions, each 1-5 points)
map.📚 深度解析：评估（质量/优化/改进）机制: 📚 In-Depth Analysis: Assessment (Quality / Optimisation / Improvement) Mechanism
map.健身机构/教练自评训练方案或体测方案的科学性、全面性、准确性、专业性、可执行性五: A fitness institution or coach self-assesses the scientificity, comprehensiveness, accuracy, professionalism and actionability of a training or physical-testing scheme across five quality dimensions.
map.用 5 维评分定位方案短板（任意维度≤2 自动标红「待改进」），指导迭代优化。: Use the 5-dimension scoring to pinpoint scheme weaknesses (any dimension ≤2 is automatically flagged red as "To improve") and guide iterative optimisation.
map.团队复盘评估体系质量，以总分/均值作为培训与流程改进的 KPI。: Teams review the assessment-system quality, using the total score / mean as a KPI for training and process improvement.
map.五维各 1–5 分：方案科学性 4、项目全面性 4、数据准确性 3、解读专业性: Five dimensions each 1-5: scheme scientificity 4, item comprehensiveness 4, data accuracy 3, interpretation professionalism 5, recommendation actionability 4. Total 20/25, mean avg=4.0 → grade "Good assessment quality" (3.5≤avg<4.5). The weak dimension is data accuracy (3), listed as the improvement focus. If all five are 5, 25 points = excellent; if all 2, 10 points = poor.
map.五个维度怎么理解？: How should the five dimensions be understood?
map.科学性=依据是否前沿合理；全面性=是否覆盖关键指标；准确性=数据/算法误差大小；: Scientificity = whether the basis is advanced and reasonable; comprehensiveness = whether key indicators are covered; accuracy = the size of the data/algorithm error; professionalism = the depth of interpretation; actionability = whether the user can put it into practice. The five together determine the scheme's credibility.
map.均值 4.0 还要改吗？: With a mean of 4.0, is there still anything to improve?
map.均值 4.0 属良好，但若有维度≤2 会拉低可信度（本例数据准确性 3 虽>2: A mean of 4.0 is good, but any dimension ≤2 lowers credibility (here data accuracy of 3 is above 2 but still low). Focus on raising the 3-and-below dimensions to 4+, especially avoiding any ≤2 hard flaw.
